notes.title: New Release
Bugfixes
Autocomplete for TYPEs
notes.notes:
The new update features autocomplete for TYPE members, like:

TYPE Tfoo
   bar
ENTYTPE

LOCAL myfoo[] AS Tfoo

myfoo. <Press Ctrl+Space here>
